text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v3.8 -> 3 nodes (canary 5%). route: stable -> canary. snapshot: sha1:abc123
alice: saw a small latency bump on the canary batch, p95 jumped 150ms at 10:12
raj: confirm which metric? p95 tail or request_queue?
alice: p95 tail on generation (model v3.8.1-quant). cpu on node-3 spiked
sam: reprod? any logs? paste tail of inference logs
alice: ```
2026-03-22T10:12:04Z node-3 infer latency=350ms tokens=40 model=v3.8.1-quant
2026-03-22T10:12:05Z node-3 kvcache-miss count=3
```
olga: hmm could be cache thrash from rollout mixing configs
marie: what are rollback triggers? we said p95 > 120ms over 3m window
raj: agreed. current window is 3m, 5% sample. We breached for 90s
sam: ops ask: do quickvote: rollback now or pin canary to previous version?
alice: +1 rollback. user impact risk
olga: +0 hold for 10 more mins, want to confirm if it's transient
marie: on-call approves rollback if we see 3rd consecutive minute over threshold
deploy-bot: quickvote started by @sam: vote options: rollback | pin | continue. votes: sam:rollback, alice:rollback, olga:hold, raj:rollback, marie:pin
raj: tag @eng-oncall for final ok
alice: also note change window ends in 40m, prefer rollback then re-deploy with kvcache fix
sam: rollback command: `deployctl rollback --service=inference --to=3.8.0 --reason="canary p95 spike"`
marie: i'm OK to pin instead of full rollback if we can pin canary routing to 0% -- less blast
olga: pin + monitor? will that avoid extra churn
raj: pinning route to 0%: `deployctl route set --service=inference --canary=0`
sam: decision: rollback. marie: i'll follow up with release note and postmortem template
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by @sam at 2026-03-22T10:15:30Z. Status: in-progress
alice: monitoring token. watching p95
raj: network team says node-3 had an infra drift during that minute
olga: after rollback, schedule a brief post-rollback sweep for kvcache config
marie: adding release note: "Rollback v3.8.1-quant canary due to p95 latency spike; pinned back to v3.8.0; follow-up: kvcache tuning"
sam: closing quickvote. thanks all :thumbsup:
